label: Fliodhais system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a two-component Fliodhais locus that can reduce Lactococcus bacteriophage c2 plaque development.
observations: Fliodhais branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Fliodhais genes, Fliodhais proteins, DefenseFinder article-registry rows, source-database rows naming one Fliodhais locus, the c2 plaque morphology itself, unresolved Fliodhais triggers or effector activities, and other phage-defense systems.
